provenance.acquisition_limit: Registry records an official source and a Hugging Face mirror. Exact original download route and byte identity to a newly downloaded UNSW copy have not been established.
provenance.limitation: Lab-generated network traffic, finite historical categories, imbalance and exact feature overlap. This replay is not a live attack, an independent dataset, a prevention system or online learning.
